registry_name: Warp & Weft AI Master Model Registry

paradigms.deterministic: Classical zero-training signal processing and spatial analysis
paradigms.feature_regression: Statistical texture feature extraction mapped to thread count via shallow regressor
paradigms.deep_segmentation: Pixel-level semantic or instance segmentation of yarn bodies and floats
paradigms.foundation_backbone: Pretrained self-supervised vision representations for transfer learning
paradigms.hybrid_metrology: Learned yarn segmentation coupled with topological skeletonization and calibrated pitch measurement

models.official_name: Dual-Engine Spectral & Spatial Deterministic Fabric Analyzer
models.architecture: 2D Fast Fourier Transform (rfft2) + 1D Spatial Autocorrelation & Prominence Peak Detection

output_format.diagnostic_spectra: 2D Power spectrum and 1D marginal projection profiles

models.suitability_rating: 5/5 (Authoritative Production Baseline for Plain Weaves with Known Scale)
models.failure_modes_and_boundary_conditions: Harmonic ambiguity on twill/satin float weaves; low optical contrast; non-periodic patterns; macro-stripe surface interference.

models.official_name: FabricNET Global 262-d Texture Feature Random Forest Regressor
models.architecture: GLCM (96) + LBP (54) + Gabor Filter Bank (96) + Spatial Projection (16) -> Scikit-learn RandomForestRegressor

input_requirements.resolution: Fixed 640x480 (assumes nominal 5x4 mm FOV: Sx=1280, Sy=1200 px/cm)

models.suitability_rating: 3/5 (Effective on fixed microscope FOV; completely fails on variable smartphone distance)
models.failure_modes_and_boundary_conditions: Implicit optical scale dependency; failure under magnification changes; optical blur.

models.official_name: FabricNET Global 262-d Texture Feature XGBoost Regressor
models.architecture: 262-d Statistical Texture Vector -> Gradient Boosted Decision Trees (XGBRegressor)
models.suitability_rating: 3/5 (High fixed-FOV accuracy; fails on smartphone domain transfer)
models.failure_modes_and_boundary_conditions: Severe sensitivity to high-frequency sensor noise and out-of-distribution blur.

models.official_name: WarpWeftUNet: Deep Semantic Yarn Core Segmenter
models.architecture: Lightweight PyTorch U-Net (4 downsampling stages, DoubleConv blocks, skip connections, bilinear upsampling)

input_requirements.resolution: 256x256 (supports arbitrary size via overlapping patch tiling)

models.quantization_onnx_support: TorchScript, ONNX, TensorRT, INT8 Quantization supported
models.suitability_rating: 4/5 (Clean yarn core segmentation; pairs with topological thinning for metrology)
models.failure_modes_and_boundary_conditions: Currently trained on synthetic microscope swatches; requires fine-tuning on real smartphone masks to bridge fiber fuzz.

models.official_name: SegFormer B0: Efficient Transformer Semantic Yarn Segmenter
models.architecture: Hierarchical Mix Vision Transformer (MiT-B0) + All-MLP Decoder Head
models.suitability_rating: 4/5 (Strong self-attention over periodic grid patterns; lightweight footprint)
models.failure_modes_and_boundary_conditions: Needs fine-tuning on textile masks; requires patch-based tiling for multi-megapixel smartphone images.

models.official_name: SAM 2.1 Tiny (Segment Anything Model 2.1 Hiera Tiny)
models.architecture: Hiera Vision Transformer + Memory Bank + Lightweight Promptable Mask Decoder
models.suitability_rating: 3/5 (Excellent for interactive ROI segmentation; does NOT automatically count threads)
models.failure_modes_and_boundary_conditions: Prompt-dependent; cannot enumerate hundreds of dense parallel yarns without automatic dense grid prompting.

models.architecture: Vision Transformer (Patch 14x14, 384 embedding dim, 6 heads, 12 layers)

input_requirements.format: RGB float32 tensor [B, 3, H, W] where H, W are multiples of 14

models.suitability_rating: 4/5 (Dense patch features preserve spatial phase of periodic weave grids; ideal for linear probe regression)
models.failure_modes_and_boundary_conditions: Requires custom downstream regression or segmentation head; scale-unaware without external calibration.

models.architecture: CSPDarknet53 Backbone + PANet Neck + ProtoNet Mask Decoder
models.suitability_rating: 3/5 (Requires 1D directional NMS; isotropic NMS suppresses 31-50% of dense yarns)
models.failure_modes_and_boundary_conditions: Severe NMS suppression on adjacent parallel yarns; integer box counts do not yield threads/cm without metric scale.

models.architecture: Vision Transformer Encoder-Decoder with Cross-Attention between Exemplar and Image

output_format.density_map: Continuous 2D float32 density map [B, 1, 384, 384] where sum(map) = object count

models.suitability_rating: 3/5 (Continuous density map solves discrete NMS suppression; requires exemplar patch)
models.failure_modes_and_boundary_conditions: Exemplar patch quality sensitivity; high GPU memory footprint; non-trivial conversion to directional warp vs weft.

models.official_name: Hybrid WarpWeftUNet + Topological Thinning + Calibrated Pitch Profiler
models.architecture: WarpWeftUNet (1.93M) -> Morphological Centerline Thinning -> 1D Pitch Histogram -> Calibrated Density (D = S / Delta)

output_format.centerline_overlay: Visual verification image showing exact detected yarn spines

models.quantization_onnx_support: TorchScript / ONNX for U-Net; native CPU for thinning
models.suitability_rating: 5/5 (Physical Metrology Architecture: Transparent Pitch Measurement with Visual Evidence)
models.failure_modes_and_boundary_conditions: Severe fiber fuzz bridging adjacent yarns on rough denim; requires human-verified masks for fine-tuning.
